units.stats: points (u8 in record, u16 on player object)
units.speed: 1/256 pixel per frame (24.8 fixed point position units)

level_range.note: level = 50 + max{i: XP >= table[i]} (0x080135D2); see levels.json

stat_points.note: LevelUp 0x08013678 adds 3*(new-old) to record+0x2C; spent 1:1 on the Status screen (VERIFIED emu)

level_up.note: per level gained: 4 rand(256) draws -> HP/EP growth (see growth); HP and EP refilled to the new max. STR/POW/END/SPD do NOT grow automatically.

movement.dash_input: double-tap a direction within 20 frames (idle state 0x08013022)

record_layout.+0x00: u8 ? (2 after new game; 3 for Goku in Snakeway state)
record_layout.+0x02: u16 fusion components: bits0-3 char A, bits4-7 char B, bits8-15 level
record_layout.+0x04: u32 SS cooldown/fatigue counter (decremented by (rec+0x62)>>6 per frame in normal form, 0x08013E06); SS needs it == 0
record_layout.+0x0C: u8 number of known energy skills
record_layout.+0x2E+2n: u8 skill level (0..2) for slot n, +0x2F+2n duplicate/max
record_layout.+0x3C/+0x40/+0x44/+0x48: u32 equipped item id: body / hands / feet / accessory (equipment table)
record_layout.+0x4C..+0x54: u16 effective STR, POW, END(melee def), END2(energy def), SPD (after equipment + Holy Water), RecalcStats 0x08013C66
record_layout.+0x56: u8 energy-attack cost factor /16 (16 = 100%; Dragon Armor halves)
record_layout.+0x57: u8 energy-block cost factor /16 (Mystic Aegis, Magician's Gloves halve)
record_layout.+0x60: u16 block damage factor /65536 (0x1000 = 1/16; Jade Keiko halves)
record_layout.+0x62: u16 SS cooldown rate (0x4000; Super items x7/8)
record_layout.+0x64: u16 HP regen per frame /256 ("Z" Armor 5*0x445>>8 = 21)
record_layout.+0x66: s8 crit bonus percent (Charge Gloves 5, Shock Boots 10, Soccer Cleats 20) -> obj+0x1BC = n*656
